title: A DEFINE TABLE can be evaluated by name; its column is named after the query table

source.quote: The syntax after TABLE defines a query table, which has a data lineage and it is populated in an empty filter context before the query is executed.
source.supports: the page defines this table and refers to its column as Colors[Color]

derivation: DISTINCT ( Product[Color] ) with no filter is Red, Blue, Green. The query table is a table of its own, and the page refers to its column as Colors[Color], so that is the name of the result column.
alternative: The page shows Colors[Color] in an expression, not as the name of a result column. If the result keeps the name of the source column instead, the column is Product[Color], with the same three rows.
